title: Saving
description: Keeping the pilot. The feature document, saving.md, is the primary record.

entities.name: Save at a station, return to the save on death
entities.description: The pilot saves under a name while docked; death and loading return to that save.
entities.behavior: Two copies of the pilot are kept: the playing one and the saved one. Saving names the pilot, copies it to the saved pilot and writes its record under the name; loading on the title reads a record, and when it is accepted it becomes both the saved and the playing pilot. Death and starting from the title make the playing pilot a copy of the saved one.
entities.outcome: What the pilot has earned lasts between sessions, and only as far as the last save.
constraints: A name is 1 to 7 of A–Z and 0–9, letters stored in capitals (validate_name); an empty name saves nothing.
A missing or rejected record changes nothing.

entities.name: A record that cannot be edited into an impossible pilot
entities.description: A record read back is accepted only when it is whole, in range and its check matches.
entities.behavior: A record is LodeStar's own text: a header with the format version, one line per saved field, and a CRC-32 check over the canonical text. Missing fields take the start pilot's values before the check; a wrong header or version, a malformed, out-of-range or repeated field, or a missing or wrong check rejects it.
entities.outcome: A hand-edited or damaged record never puts the sim in a state the rules do not allow.
constraints: VERSION is 1; another version is rejected.
It does not read or write the baseline's records (deliberate difference 11).

relatedViews.relationship: The pilot's goals that exercise it.
Stores and fetches the records as files.
